oe_yw.4 = { # 进封梁王
    type = country_event
    outcome = neutral
    title = oe_yw.4.t
    desc = { first_valid = { triggered_desc = { trigger = { country_exists = c:LNG c:LNG = { ruler ?= character:bolot_borjigin } } desc = oe_yw.4.d1 } desc = oe_yw.4.d } }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior 10 = happy }
    trigger = { tag = CHI oe_yw_can_4 = yes }
    immediate = {
        event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:nobles_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w3 } country_exists = c:LNG c:LNG = { is_ai = yes NOT = { ruler ?= character:bolot_borjigin } } oe_yw_bolot_in_lng = yes } c:LNG = { set_new_ruler = character:bolot_borjigin } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w3 value = 1 } debug_log = "oe_yw: W3 Bolod succeeds as Prince of Yunnan" } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_w3 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yw_w3 value = 2 } }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_yw.4.a
        historical_option = yes
        custom_tooltip = oe_yw.4.a.tt
        hidden_effect = { c:LNG ?= { oe_yw_set_ev = { amount = 10 months = 60 } } set_variable = { name = oe_yw_job value = 41 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yw.20 }
        ai_chance = { base = 85 }
    }

        name = oe_yw.4.b

# Hidden worker, fired from options of oe_yw.2 and .4 (CHI) with the country var oe_yw_job.
oe_yw.20 = {
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    title = oe_yw.20.t
    trigger = { has_variable = oe_yw_job }
    immediate = {
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_job = 21 } oe_yw_job_console = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_job = 41 } oe_yw_job_liang = yes }
        remove_variable = oe_yw_job
    }
}
